---
title: "Data Explorer"
---

This page lets you explore all **2,569 weekly observations** in the Drake Billboard Hot 100 dataset. Use the search bars at the top of each column to filter by song, rank, or date.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

drake_table <- read_csv("data/drake_billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  select(
    `Chart Date` = week_date,
    `Rank` = week_position,
    `Song Title` = song,
    `Performer Credit` = performer,
    `Peak Rank` = peak_position,
    `Weeks on Chart` = weeks_on_chart
  ) |> 
  arrange(desc(`Chart Date`), `Rank`)

datatable(
  drake_table,
  filter = "top",
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = "hover stripe compact",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 20,
    lengthMenu = c(10, 20, 50, 100),
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    scrollX = TRUE
  )
)
```
